literal: Enduring living beings all having made to sleep, showing mercy, the night, except me, does not have a companion.
translation: Having put all living beings to sleep and comforted them, the night has no companion left but me.
modern: நிலைபெற்ற உயிர்கள் எல்லாவற்றையும் தூங்கச் செய்து அவற்றுக்கு அருள் புரியும் இந்த இரவுக்கு, என்னைத் தவிர வேறு துணை இல்லை.
explanation: The heroine, suffering from the intense pain of separation, is unable to sleep. She looks around and realizes that the night has kindly put all other living creatures to sleep, granting them peaceful rest. Since everyone else is asleep, only she and the night remain awake in the darkness. She poetically expresses that the night, too, is lonely and has found no companion other than her to share its long hours.
